name: paper-search
description: Discover and triage academic papers in a local swipe interface.

interface.shortDescription: Find and triage research papers by swiping.
interface.longDescription: Paper Search helps discover academic papers, presents them in a private local swipe interface, and uses saved feedback to refine later recommendations.
defaultPrompt: Find papers about a topic and let me triage them.
Refine my paper recommendations from my feedback.
